how_brands_deliver_content: Not verifiable in this session: carrefouruae.com returned empty pages or gateway errors to every request and no Majid Al Futtaim marketplace seller documentation could be reached. Syndigo publishes Carrefour pages, but they do not mention the UAE or Majid Al Futtaim, so they are not treated as evidence for this market. The seller-onboarding route, content template and language rules (English/Arabic) therefore remain unconfirmed.

official_quality_signals.notes: No official content or listing-quality score is documented in the public pages that could be retrieved.

limitations: No Carrefour UAE requirement could be verified; the rules array is empty. The official site could not be loaded and no reachable secondary source quoting its rules was identified. Web search was unavailable when this retailer was researched (shared search budget exhausted), so discovery relied on directly reachable official and content-partner pages.
